assistant._note: The Telegram front door: full history, 54 tool schemas, vision. The one role that CANNOT drop to Haiku -- it inherits the whole context, and Haiku 4.5 caps at 200K against Opus 5's 1M. Effort is the cost lever here, not the model.

goal_planner._note: Reads full context and emits self-contained steps. Stays on Opus at high effort on purpose: every downstream Haiku step is only as good as the instructions written here, so this is the wrong place to save money.

_note: NOT Haiku, and that is load-bearing -- see the comment at executor.py:33.
This route already ran on Haiku for cost and regressed three ways:
narrate-instead-of-deliver stalls, 'let me compile this' tails, and a
turn truncated mid-tool_use that 400'd a whole plan.
The reason is that the executor is not the thin worker its name suggests.
Its INPUT is small (executor.py queues instructions + objective, not the
conversation) -- but it then loads all 54 tool schemas plus server-side
web search and runs up to MAX_STEP_TURNS + 3 turns per step. That is a
small-input agent loop, not a single cheap call, and it is the loop that
Cost lever here is effort (now actually wired), not the model tier.

ingest._note: Vault ingest. Bulk, mechanical, already Haiku.

code_reviewer._note: Reads a diff in a fresh context to catch what the implementer missed. Downgrading this is a false saving -- a missed bug costs more than the tokens.

embeddings._note: The one surviving OpenAI dependency: Anthropic ships no embedding model, so vault_recall's pgvector index has nowhere else to go. Every other OpenAI route was removed on 2026-08-10.
